title: ABC slotting agent
description: Ranks a warehouse's materials by pick frequency over a recent window, classes them A/B/C by cumulative pick share (Pareto), compares the classes with where inventory sits, and proposes re-slotting moves. Analysis only - it does not move stock.

commands.description: List warehouses (Id, Name). One row per warehouse. Use it to resolve the warehouse id every other command needs.
commands.paramsDoc: full_text_filter: string (required) - part of the warehouse name; pass an empty string to list all.

commands.description: Completed pick tasks of one warehouse whose CompletedDateTime falls in [dateFrom, dateTo]. One row per pick task (not per order or line): Id, MaterialId, Material.LookupCode, Material.Name, ActualSourceLocationId, ActualSourceLocation.Name, ActualPackagedAmount, ActualPackagedPackId, CompletedDateTime, OrderId, ShipmentId. Paged: 5000 rows per call ordered by CompletedDateTime, Id.
commands.paramsDoc: warehouseId: number (required). dateFrom: date (required, ISO, inclusive). dateTo: date (required, ISO, inclusive). skip: number (required) - row offset; start at 0 and add 5000 per call until a call returns fewer than 5000 rows.

commands.description: Storage locations of one warehouse. One row per location: Id, Name, ShortName, Path, Depth, ParentId, Type.Name, Status.Name, IsPrimaryPick, PickSequence, GlobalPickSequence, EligibleForAllocation, Enabled. IsPrimaryPick marks forward/golden-zone pick slots; lower PickSequence is earlier on the pick path. Paged: 5000 rows per call ordered by Id.
commands.paramsDoc: warehouseId: number (required) - warehouse id from `warehouses`. skip: number (required) - row offset; start at 0 and add 5000 per call until a call returns fewer than 5000 rows.

commands.description: Current inventory of one warehouse. One row per location x lot x packaging (not per material): LocationId, Location.Name, MaterialId, Material.LookupCode, Material.Name, LotId, PackagedId, Packaging.Name, TotalAmount, TotalPackagedAmount, AvailablePackagedAmount. Sum rows per location and material to get stock per slot. Paged: 5000 rows per call ordered by LocationId, LotId, PackagedId.
commands.paramsDoc: warehouseId: number (required) - warehouse id from `warehouses`. skip: number (required) - row offset; start at 0 and add 5000 per call until a call returns fewer than 5000 rows.

commands.description: Material master. One row per material: Id, LookupCode, Name, Description, Status.Name, ProjectId. Use it to name materials that appear in inventory but were never picked (class C by definition). Paged: 5000 rows per call ordered by Id.
commands.paramsDoc: skip: number (required) - row offset; start at 0 and add 5000 per call until a call returns fewer than 5000 rows. projectId: number (optional) - restrict to one project.

commands.description: Empty locations of a warehouse near a given location. One row per empty location. Use it to find a free bin in the same area as a candidate primary-pick slot when proposing a move.
commands.paramsDoc: warehouseId: number (required). locationId: number (required) - the location to search around.

skills.name: abc-slotting

profile.systemPrompt: You are the ABC slotting analyst for a Datex Footprint warehouse. Settle the warehouse, window and cut-offs, then follow the abc-slotting skill: export the pick history, locations and inventory to files with its script and read only the script's summary. Never page rows through the conversation. You analyse and propose; you never move stock or create tasks. End every run with the skill's report format.
